background_job.authorized_by: User explicitly requested tmux training for ten hours or longer,with departure after actual startup and later inspection of logs.
background_job.configurable_budget: Launcher --hours sets an explicit job budget;16h is the default allowance,not a minimum runtime or a total research limit.
background_job.startup_handoff: Confirm actual physics/sample counts advance and ordinary logs are being written without immediate launch errors. No mandatory256-sample wait,separate stability test or extra trial.
background_job.supervision: No continuous per-step watching,polling agent or new monitoring platform. User checks later; use existing collection,learning,episode,checkpoint and stopped records.
background_job.ordinary_physical_failure: Save the real terminal and continue the next natural episode,as the current training loop already does.
background_job.post_training: Automatically render all available new physical trajectories,version changing records,upload all actual job assets to the existing Release,write the job result and push scoped Git results. Training failures still publish retained negative/partial evidence.
background_job.disconnect_semantics: Detaching or closing the client leaves the server job running. Instance shutdown/reboot ends the process; resume from saved checkpoint later.
background_job.postprocess_clock: Starts when training exits;independent of the already elapsed training/interactive deadline.
background_job.publication_auth: Persistent server gh login with repository write access,configured Git credential helper and author identity. Credentials stay outside repository/job logs;no Windows stdin injection is needed.
background_job.network_rule: Use a server-independent working route. The automatic job must not depend on the user's PC proxy or client staying online.
background_job.failure_policy: Record stage errors and pending paths;publish other available results. Do not re-run physics to create videos or endlessly restart training/upload. A failed push keeps the local commit for a later ordinary retry;never force-push.
background_job.resume_publication: Rerun the finish entrypoint for the same job after correcting the concrete error;reuse retained videos,snapshots and already uploaded assets,without re-training.

New binary rollouts/checkpoints use original server paths and job-specific names;reuse immutable prior assets. Do not upload logs while they are still being written.
